rule: Rows or namespaces in GloBI that are explicit mirrors/adapters of Mangal, the already-adjudicated first primary source that terminated at HOLD_MANGAL_SPECIES_RANK_SUPPORT, cannot count as independent second-source evidence for the GloBI route.
reason: The finite-family source switch was authorized because the first source failed pre-outcome support. Re-importing the same underlying source through the second-source integrator would not constitute an independent source and could silently rescue the failed source via a different taxonomic transformation.
